task: Fix the current Phase 11 branch after host validation. The implementation commit 2beca1f is otherwise complete, but cargo test fails on Windows because capture_providers_are_bounded_and_fail_closed asserts that WindowsScreenVisionCaptureProvider must error even when the host successfully captures the primary display. Make the focused test truthful and portable: accept a successful capture only when bytes are non-empty and <= the declared bound, still accept the bounded unavailable/oversized/failed outcomes, and separately assert cancellation is fail-closed. Add/adjust focused assertions for Deterministic and Local visual adapters (fixture success, real-model unavailable, cancellation) without weakening production behavior. Correct docs/PHASE_11_SCREEN_VISION_SPEC.md and any related roadmap/README language that still says Phase 11 has no Windows screenshot API or no real pixels; state that capture is now real Windows-only and on-demand, while the local model is intentionally unavailable/degraded unless installed and raw bytes are transient. Run cargo fmt/check/clippy/full and focused tests, contracts typecheck/build/tests, desktop typecheck/tests/build, secrets scan and diff check. Commit the correction with a descriptive message; do not push or publish.
constraints: Use the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents and no direct manual code edits outside the Executor.
Do not turn a host-dependent successful capture into a fabricated failure; preserve the actual real-provider path and bounded cleanup.
Keep no continuous capture, no network/upload, no raw screenshot persistence, and preserve Owner/privacy/safe-mode/idempotency controls.
Do not modify Phase 12 Android or Phase 13 gateway behavior; do not push, merge, tag, release or deploy.

review_findings.title: Focused Rust test fails on Windows host
review_findings.details: cargo test --locked --lib and screen_vision::tests fail at capture_providers_are_bounded_and_fail_closed because the real GDI provider successfully returns bounded pixels on this Windows host, contrary to the test's hard-coded error assertion. The test must cover both valid bounded success and fail-closed outcomes.

review_findings.title: Phase 11 spec contradicts shipped capture provider
review_findings.details: docs/PHASE_11_SCREEN_VISION_SPEC.md still lists a Windows screenshot API and real pixels as explicit non-goals and describes only synthetic fixtures. Update the truth boundary to distinguish real on-demand capture from intentionally unavailable local-model analysis.
